caption: The drawing depicts a textile with a repeating pattern of horizontal stripes and geometric motifs. The textile is composed of alternating bands of dark brown, white, and thinner lines of blue, with some segments featuring gold or yellow diamond and starburst shapes. The central motifs, positioned within the white bands, include symmetrical arrangements of blue and gold diamond-shaped elements. The brown stripes are relatively thick and solid, while the blue lines are thinner and run parallel near the edges of the brown stripes. The design appears to be mirrored along the central vertical seam, which divides the textile into two nearly identical halves; the seam is visible as a white stitch running down the middle. The colors used are primarily brown, white, blue, and gold/yellow. The textile is mounted on a plain, beige backing paper, and there is a small handwritten note at the top left that reads "TOP."
title: Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
